cards.text: Big day, friend. Moses, Israel's leader, finishes setting up the tabernacle and anoints and consecrates it, with all its furnishings, the altar and all its utensils. Meanwhile I can't put together one cooling rack without three screws left over.

cards.question: The tabernacle is set up, and the men who supervised the registration come to present an offering. Who are they?

cards.text: These leaders are the heads of their families. They bring their offering before the LORD and present it in front of the tabernacle.

cards.question: What do the tribal leaders bring before the LORD at the tabernacle?

answers.text: Six covered carts and twelve oxen

cards.text: An ox from each leader and a cart from every two. Most gifts you can wrap, but this one has HOOVES.

cards.question: Then the LORD speaks to Moses. What does He say to do with the carts and oxen?

answers.text: Accept them for the Tent's work
Send them back to the leaders
Offer them on the new altar

cards.question: The LORD says to give the carts and oxen to the Levites, the tribe that serves at the tabernacle (Numbers 3:6-7). True or false: He says to split the carts and oxen evenly, the same for every man.

cards.text: So Moses hands the carts and oxen to the Levites. The Gershonites, one Levite clan, get two carts and four oxen, and the Merarites, another clan, get four carts and eight oxen.

cards.question: The Merarites get their carts and oxen under someone's direction. Whose?

cards.text: That's all six carts handed out. And the Kohathites, another Levite clan, get ZERO carts and ZERO oxen.

cards.question: Why do the Kohathites get no carts or oxen?

answers.text: They carry the holy objects on their shoulders
They camp too far from the tabernacle
They already have carts of their own

cards.text: The Kohathites: the only movers whose truck is their own shoulders. When the altar is anointed, the leaders bring offerings for its dedication and present them before the altar.

cards.question: Twelve leaders, one altar, and each leader gets his own turn. The LORD tells Moses that each ___, one leader is to present his offering for the dedication.

cards.text: Twelve days, twelve leaders, and the EXACT same offering every time: a silver platter, a silver bowl, a gold dish of incense, and animals for burnt, sin and peace offerings. Nahshon son of Amminadab from Judah goes first, and by the end the silver alone weighs two thousand four hundred shekels. Twelve guys bring the same gift to the same party, and I bet nobody's embarrassed. I love it.
One more moment before this chapter closes. Moses goes into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD.

cards.question: Inside the Tent of Meeting, Moses hears the voice speaking to him. Where does the voice come from?

answers.text: Above the mercy seat on the ark
Beside the altar in the courtyard
Behind the curtain at the door
